entity.name: Ashwith Poojary
entity.description: Independent open-source developer from Bengaluru, India, building tools for LLM and RAG evaluation, monitoring, and enterprise use. Passionate about making AI tooling accessible, transparent, and community-driven.

projects.name: LLMEvalOps
projects.description: Open-source, enterprise-ready platform for benchmarking, monitoring, and managing LLM & RAG applications. Features include multi-tenant support, RBAC, structured evaluation workflows, 20+ metrics (via RAGAS/LangChain integrations), and hybrid Java/Python backend with modern frontend.
